videoHero.reference: User-generated 16 and memory sculpture video following the NOMI-inspired direction.
videoHero.mediaSource: User-provided local video; original file not included in this repository.
videoHero.license: User provided the local video for website integration. Generator and provider-specific usage rights were not independently verified.
videoHero.keyframeInterval: Preserved from the original video stream
videoHero.adaptation: Video stream remuxed without re-encoding; audio omitted. Native file 1280x720, 16:9, no baked crop, padding or synthetic sky. One source at every breakpoint. Desktop container prefers 16:9 and caps its height at 80% of the hero; mobile container is the lower 56%. CSS object-fit cover uniformly scales with peripheral scenery cropping; ultrawide screens use contain. Original dark cover palette and white typography restored; tablet and short landscape type have explicit sizes. The source's original small loop discontinuity is retained. Real silent 0.7x playback, scroll seeking and reduced-motion pause.
videoHero.transport: Native same-origin looping video. The cover is exactly one viewport with no sticky scroll timeline. Scrolling moves directly to the next section; video pauses offscreen and resumes on return. Poster remains behind the stream. No video seeking.
